_about: update-28: the fixed asset register of Zoho Books (Fixed Assets module) against the sheets FA Add and Dep.Calc. Read by lib/register.mjs. A new year needs its own copy (register.fy27.json). 'types' turns the group named on a sheet into the asset type of Zoho; 'ledgerGroups' are the groups that are not in the register (their lines are looked for in the ledger of their own account, by amount); 'notInRegister' are the groups of Dep.Calc. that the register does not hold. Ids are Zoho's own (probe of 21-Oct-2026).
